lint.not_a_spec: This file is not a Saka spec: its frontmatter needs saka: spec.
lint.file_too_large: The spec is {bytes} bytes; the limit is {max_bytes} bytes.
lint.invalid_utf8: The spec is not valid UTF-8 text.
lint.slug_invalid: The file name gives the slug "{slug}", which is not valid: use lowercase letters, digits, and dashes.
lint.title_missing: The spec needs a title: a level-1 heading (# Title).
lint.ac_section_missing: The spec needs an "Acceptance criteria" section.
lint.ac_id_invalid: "{id}" is not a valid acceptance criterion ID; use AC-01, AC-02, and so on.
lint.ac_id_duplicate: {id} is used for more than one acceptance criterion.
lint.steps_missing: The spec needs a Steps table or a "Done when" section.
lint.steps_column_missing: The Steps table needs a "{column}" column.
lint.steps_column_unsupported: The Steps table cannot have a "{column}" column yet.
lint.step_limit_exceeded: A spec can have at most {max_steps} steps.
lint.step_ac_empty: Step {step} does not name any acceptance criterion.
lint.step_ac_unknown: Step {step} names {ac}, which is not in the acceptance criteria.
lint.step_command_missing: Step {step} needs at least one command in "Done when".
lint.frontmatter_invalid: {reason, select, duplicate_key {The frontmatter key "{key}" appears more than once.} other {The frontmatter line "{key}" is not in the form key: value.}}
lint.priority_invalid: Priority "{value}" is not a whole number from -1000 to 1000.
lint.depends_on_invalid: depends_on "{value}" must be a list of spec slugs.
lint.depends_on_self: The spec cannot depend on itself ({slug}).
lint.step_after_unknown: Step {step} waits for {after}, which is not a step in this spec.
lint.step_after_cycle: These steps wait for each other in a loop: {steps}.
lint.done_when_with_steps: Use either a Steps table or a "Done when" section, not both.
lint.done_when_item_invalid: "Done when" item {item} needs exactly one command in backticks.
lint.ac_uncovered: {ac} is not covered by any step.
lint.step_parallel_start: Step {step} does not wait for any other step, so it starts at the same time as S1.
lint.depends_on_unknown: The spec depends on {slug}, which is not a spec in this project.
lint.depends_on_withdrawn: The spec depends on {slug}, which was withdrawn.
lint.depends_on_cycle: The specs depend on each other in a loop: {cycle}.
lint.links_limit_exceeded: The spec has more links than the {limit} that are followed.
lint.reference_outside_workspace: The link {target} points outside the workspace.
lint.reference_not_doc: The link to {path} is not a markdown document, so it is not added as context.
lint.reference_missing: The linked document {path} does not exist on the base branch.
lint.reference_not_text: The {origin, select, always {always-included} other {linked}} document {path} is not valid UTF-8 text.
lint.reference_too_large: The {origin, select, always {always-included} other {linked}} document {path} is {bytes} bytes; the limit is {limit} bytes.
lint.context_too_large: {reason, select, bytes {The context documents add up to {bytes} bytes; the limit is {limit} bytes.} always_candidates {There are {count} always-included documents; the limit is {limit}.} other {The spec has {count} context documents; the limit is {limit}.}}
